answer.evidence: Sudden total loss on 2026-10-23 14:00 with RX_LOS, RX -12 to -40dBm while TX power/bias stable, so TX OK. OTDR from both ends meets at same mid-span point between SC-05 (18.392km) and SC-06 (22.568km) with reflective glass-air ends (-26.8/-24.5dB), proving fibre break not bend/splice/connector. Timing matches road works around km19 10min before alarms. B-ODF clean did not restore, ruling out connector.
